name: Aftereffect
storyline:
Long after Freddy Fazbear’s Pizza closed its doors, the tragedies that took place there only exist as tall-tales, rumors, and hoaxes. A rogue indie developer creates horror games based on these tales which takes the world by storm, inspiring a wealthy entrepreneur to revive Fazbear Entertainment. Now working to rebrand its image, the company starts work on many titles which serve to clear their image in the mind of the public.

You are Vanessa, a vastly unqualified IT worker who is down on her luck. However, in an unexpected turn of events, she is sent on a company mission by the senior manager of Fazbear Entertainment. Their goal is to visit the elusive Dekogon Industries, a robotic parts manufacturer. However, once they visit, they realize they’ve been trapped within the facility by an unknown entity. Vanessa and her unlikely accomplice will have to join forces to escape. What they find inside might be friendship, memories, or even dark secrets. Discover the truth of Fazbear Entertainment in this unique take on the Five Nights at Freddy's Universe.
summary: Vanessa is a young employee working a dead-end job, but in a twist of fate, she is sent on a company mission to go to an abandoned factory. It’s up to her to explore the secrets within and unravel the mysteries of Fazbear Entertainment in this narrative-driven game.
